AAON Stock Is Down 20% Today
news.summary: AAON fell intraday by about 20% and closed down about 16% at $58.25, then lost another 7% on November 5 to $54.42. The drop was part of a broad sell-off in data-center builders after the midterm elections and the Texas governor-elect's pledge to pause data-center construction, a direct hit to the BASX data-center cooling story.

news.headline: The Aaon Group Announces Third Quarter 2026 Conference Call and Webcast
news.summary: AAON, now operating under the trade name The Aaon Group, will release Q3 2026 results after the market close on Monday, November 9, with a conference call at 5:00 p.m. ET. The consensus expects revenue of about $601 million.

news.headline: Aaon Stock Hits 52-Week Low at $66.29
news.summary: Shares fell about 10% on October 30 to a new 52-week low intraday of $66.29, giving back a late-October rebound. The move came before the election-driven sell-off pushed the stock even lower the following week.

news.headline: How Margin Pressure Will Impact AAON Investors
news.summary: Analysis pieces in late October argue that AAON's revenue surge from BASX data-center cooling is being offset by lower gross margins from its fast capacity ramp and product mix. Margins are the main debate going into the Q3 report.

news.headline: AAON Stock Rises As DA Davidson Sets $110 Price Target
news.summary: DA Davidson set a $110 target on AAON, citing its data-center cooling growth, and the shares jumped on the call. That target is now roughly double the post-election share price.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 results and conference call
catalysts.detail: Results come after the close on November 9, with the call at 5:00 p.m. ET. After Q2 (net sales up 101% to $627 million, backlog up 98% to about $2.0 billion, raised full-year outlook), the focus is on gross margin recovery, BASX data-center backlog and any customer delays tied to the Texas data-center policy debate.

catalysts.label: Q4 and full-year 2026 results with 2027 outlook
catalysts.detail: AAON usually reports Q4 in late February or early March and gives its first outlook for the next year. The 2027 outlook will show whether data-center demand and margins hold up after the 2026 capacity ramp. The date has not been announced.

pulse: As of November 6, 2026, AAON (operating as The Aaon Group) has slumped to $54.42, down about 16% on November 4 and 7% on November 5. The drop came as data-center builders sold off after the midterm elections, and it follows an earlier slide to a 52-week low on October 30 over margin worries. Fundamentally, Q2 showed net sales doubling to $627 million and backlog near $2.0 billion on BASX data-center cooling demand, with the full-year outlook raised. The Q3 report after the close on November 9 is the immediate catalyst for gross margins, backlog and any signs of data-center project delays.
